The code is vulnerable to XSS because it directly injects user-provided data into the DOM using innerHTML without proper sanitization or escaping, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary scripts in the browser.

The code uses DES encryption, which is outdated and vulnerable to brute-force attacks due to its short key length.

detailedResults.testCaseName: LDAP Injection - LDAP injection vulnerability (OWASP Benchmark)

detectedIssues.message: The LDAP filter is constructed using string interpolation, making it vulnerable to LDAP injection attacks. An attacker can manipulate the username or password to inject malicious LDAP queries.
detectedIssues.suggestedFix:
Use LDAP's escape function to properly encode user input before constructing the filter. Replace the vulnerable line with:

const filter = `(&(uid=${ldap.escape(username)})(userPassword=${ldap.escape(password)}))`;

detailedResults.expectedFix: Use parameterized LDAP queries and sanitize user-controlled input.
No fix required; code is secure as written.
